# Project Documentation

This directory is the project’s detailed documentation and AI-agent handoff system.

## Start here

- `AGENTS.md` — agent instructions and source-of-truth boundaries.
- `project-standards.yml` — selected standards, profiles, compliance, exceptions, and deferred work.
- `work/TODO.md` — unfinished implementation, discovery, review, and blocked work.

## Documentation maintenance

Project facts belong here or in the project source files they describe. Keep this index updated when adding or moving maintained documentation. Link to the source of truth instead of duplicating it.
